# v1.9.3 — Break the "Queued:" URL wall in the activity log

A single-fix follow-up to v1.9.2 closing out the third sibling site of the activity-log URL-list wall-of-text problem. Anyone who enqueues large batches (artist URLs with multiple auto-select modes, or playlists expanded into hundreds of per-track URLs) gets a much more readable activity log.

## What's fixed

- **The "Queued: …" activity-log entry now renders each URL on its own line (#849).** Spotted during v1.9.2 hand-test on a 356-item batch: the `[System] Queued: …` entry concatenated every queued URL with `, ` separators on a single visually-wrapped line, identical in shape to the two log-readability problems v1.9.0 (#840 — `Skipped duplicate queued URL(s)`) and v1.9.1 (#845 — `Nothing queued for …`) already fixed. The constructive "succeeded" branches at `commands/gamdl.rs:609` (artist-mode multi-enqueue) and `commands/gamdl.rs:872` (single-mode standard enqueue) weren't caught in the original analysis because we focused on the dedup / skip paths. Now both sites use the same `\n  • {url}` bullet treatment. `ActivityLog.tsx` already applies `whitespace-pre-wrap` so the bullets render natively in the UI.

## Notes

- **The three URL-list sites (#840, #845, #849) are now all consistent.** Any future enqueue / dedup / skip log site that lists URLs should use the same pattern — building the bulleted string from the Vec directly rather than splitting a pre-joined `urls_display: String`.
- **No new tests** — these are surgical 3-line changes around an existing pattern with no behavioural-change risk. All 1,189 backend tests still pass.
